# Preflight

> Preflight is a set of GitLab CI/CD components for Wayne State apps. Include them and your pipeline runs PROCTOR, PHP tests on each supported version, a Composer audit, an SBOM, Pint, PHPStan and ESLint.

**Every push is cleared for takeoff.**

Preflight is a set of GitLab CI/CD components that give every WSU app the
same checks: PROCTOR, PHP tests on each supported version, Composer audit,
an SBOM, Pint, PHPStan and ESLint.

**Not to be confused with:** Preflight is the CI pipeline; it runs Pinstripe's style checks and PROCTOR but sets neither.

Front page: [`site/index.html`](https://github.com/waynestate/preflight/blob/HEAD/site/index.html), a static page; see [`site/README.md`](https://github.com/waynestate/preflight/blob/HEAD/site/README.md).
On Citadel it is served by the raw-PHP deploy layer in [`deploy/`](https://github.com/waynestate/preflight/blob/HEAD/deploy/): a Squire kit whose front controller serves `site/` behind HELMET's security headers. For local development, keep serving `site/` directly.

Development happens on Wayne State's GitLab; this repository is a release mirror. Changes land there first.

Components are GA on the Free tier since GitLab 17.0. They work only within
the same GitLab instance that hosts this project.

Every page below is Markdown. The HTML pages send the same Markdown to a client that asks for `text/markdown`. Written by Squire's agent-ready kit from the README and the pages; do not edit.

## Pages

- [Preflight: Every push is cleared for takeoff.](https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/index.md): Preflight is a set of GitLab CI/CD components for Wayne State apps. Include them and your pipeline runs PROCTOR, PHP tests on each supported version, a Composer audit, an SBOM, Pint, PHPStan and ESLint.

## Prompts

- [Get started with Preflight](https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-get-started): The agent writes your app's .gitlab-ci.yml with the components that fit it, whether it's raw PHP, Laravel with Blade, or Laravel with Inertia and Vue. The prompt itself is in https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Preflight on a package's GitHub mirror](https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-github-mirror): Components can't leave their GitLab instance, so a waynestate/ package mirrored to GitHub calls Preflight's reusable workflow instead. The prompt itself is in https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.
- [Version upkeep with Preflight's Renovate preset](https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/#prompt-renovate): One renovate.json that extends the shared preset. Patch and minor updates merge themselves when the pipeline is green; majors wait for a person. The prompt itself is in https://preflight.apps.wayne.edu/index.md.

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/waynestate/preflight/blob/HEAD/README.md): the project's README, with install, commands and checks

## Optional

- [ADVISOR](https://advisor.apps.wayne.edu/llms.txt): the stack's MCP server: read-only tools that answer from CREED's policy and the parts' docs instead of from memory
- [WELD](https://weld.apps.wayne.edu/llms.txt): the Wayne State application stack: every part, and the reference app
